Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Nitin - 46 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Ayaan - 10 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
5. Aditi - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Aarav stands by the road. Neeta and Nitin stand near him.]

Neeta: "Today feels like a good day."

[Father rides the bicycle with Aarav sitting on the carrier behind him.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Neeta, Ayaan and Aditi stand near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[Aarav feeds the dog.]

Ayaan: "Careful!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Neeta: "That was fun!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav pats his horse.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Aarav stands by the road. Neeta, Ayaan and Aditi stand near him.]

Neeta: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aarav: "What next?"

[Aarav gets into the car.]

Aditi: "Show me too!"

[Aarav gets on the bus.]

Aarav (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[Aarav hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan: "This is amazing!"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bedroom. Neeta and Ayaan stand near him.]

Neeta: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Neeta: "Really?"

[Aarav sits on the edge of the bed.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
